why: Both answers make the right call to delete the fields. Advice 2 gives the reason that matters most here: inbound tourists fill out a long form on a phone in a language they may not know well, which pushes up drop-off. It also takes the asker's fear head-on and records the completion rate before the change. Advice 1's hide-instead-of-delete tip is useful, but its 'risk' about losing past data is muddled, since it treats something that can be prevented as if it were unknown.
